name: django-extensions-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is django-extensions, a collection of extensions for the Django web
framework: custom management commands, model fields, abstract model classes, validators, admin
extensions, template tags, job scheduling and other utilities for Django projects.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the django_extensions package: every Python module under django_extensions/ except the mongodb/ package, templatetags/debugger_tags.py, the management commands runserver_plus, runprofileserver, mail_debug, sync_s3, graph_models, graph_app_model_dependencies, reset_db, reset_schema, drop_test_database and sqldsn, and their helper modules management/modelviz.py, management/technical_response.py, management/notebook_extension.py and management/mysql.py; together with README.rst, the documentation pages under docs/ other than the pages for those excluded commands (docs/runserver_plus.rst, docs/runprofileserver.rst, docs/mail_debug.rst, docs/sync_s3.rst, docs/graph_models.rst, docs/reset_db.rst, docs/reset_schema.rst, docs/sqldsn.rst and docs/debugger_tags.rst), and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
